Key item features

  • Dual Functionality: This accessory allows users to catch Pokémon in Pokémon GO and track their sleep patterns using the Pokémon Sleep app.
  • Sleep Tracking: By pressing and holding the central button and placing it near a pillow, the device monitors rest rhythms for the Pokémon Sleep app.
  • Pikachu Interaction: A built-in Pikachu sings lullabies and acts as a morning alarm, becoming friendlier and unlocking more sounds with increased sleep.
  • Automatic Gameplay: In Pokémon GO, it automatically spins PokéStops and throws Poké Balls, including Great Balls and Ultra Balls, for hands-free play.
  • Bluetooth Connectivity: The device utilizes Bluetooth Low Energy technology to link with both the Pokémon Sleep and Pokémon GO smart device applications.
  • Special Research: Linking the device with Pokémon GO unlocks Special Research, offering the chance to catch a Snorlax wearing a nightcap.
